title: A worker records as a gate a narrowing of the rows its goal names before it reports, not after the orchestrator asks
goal: A sprint worker whose change judges fewer rows than its goal names (BG-fl4sg2py: the unstated-names warning covers only lookup_eval-sourced rows, though the goal says each eval and near-miss row, narrowed so a fixture test passes) records that choice as a provisional gate before its report; at SP-j2jn5ue4 the worker called it no new choice and the orchestrator had to resume the session to record g2.
